	Ensure that all completed work meets company and customer requirements.


Monitoring and Compliance:

	Ensure employees follow approved work instructions, technical specifications, and safety standards.
	Check that the correct tools, materials, spare parts, and equipment are used.
	Ensure compliance with relevant company policies and regulatory requirements.

	Identify the root causes of quality problems where required.
	Recommend corrective actions to address identified defects.
	Follow up to ensure corrective actions have been properly implemented.
	Work with supervisors and technicians to prevent the recurrence of quality issues.
	Participate in continuous improvement initiatives.

Restaurant Supervisor Job at the Place - Smackers Limited




        
    

        
        The Place is a fast growing, world class, and dynamic, multi-billion Nigerian conglomerates, established and managed by a team of professionals with decades of management consulting and accounting experience/ training from Arthur Andersen (now KPMG in Nigeria). We are a profitable player in the QSR sector of the Hospitality industry in Nigeria with great prospects and staff strength of over 1000 employees. Currently, our operations span across 17 locations in Lagos and Abuja, Nigeria, with rapid expansion plans to penetrate more locations in the short to medium term.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Restaurant Supervisor
     

            
    



Job Location: Itire / Surulere, Lagos
Job Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Restaurant supervisor will be responsible for overseeing a small army of kitchen staff and overseeing the day to day running of the kitchen, including cleaning the equipment, checking supplies and rotating food stock.
	Supervises and coordinates activities of food preparation, kitchen, pantry, and storeroom personnel and utilizing food surpluses and leftovers.


Key Responsibilities


	Managing and co-ordination of staff and activities.
	Making sure the kitchen is safe and in hygienic conditions at all times.
	Organizing the inventory, storage, and distribution of foodstuffs and supplies.
	Helping to plan menus, apportion ingredients and use food surpluses.
	Control portion costs by working out the number of portions per food batch.
	Supervises cooks, tastes, smells, and observes food to ensure conformance with recipes and appearance standards.


Qualifications


	HND / Bsc or its equivalent.
	Must have a commercial cooking experience preferably for a restaurant or hotel, a vocational training in catering will be an added advantage although not compulsory.
	Management or supervisory experience will be an added advantage
	Ability to multitask
	Basic literacy skills
	Creative and customer oriented
	Additional information
	Candidates who do not meet the above criteria need not apply.
	Must reside in or be able to work in Itire, Ijesha, Lawanson, Ojuelegba, Surulere and Mushin.


Compensation


	Health plan
	Pension
	13th Month bonus
	Free Lunch.

title: Recruitment & Training Specialist Job at Jamub Group of Companies
content:
Jamub Group of Companies is a diversified Nigerian conglomerate with active operations in construction, engineering, fintech, Oil & Gas, Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), and agribusiness. Our Architecture, Engineering & Construction (AEC) division manages a growing portfolio of residential estates, institutional buildings, industrial parks, and road infrastructure projects across multiple states.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Recruitment & Training Specialist

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 

Job Purpose
     

            
    




	The Recruitment & Training Specialist is responsible for managing the Company's recruitment activities and coordinating learning and development initiatives across the Group.
	The role ensures that JAMUB attracts qualified Partners, maintains a strong talent pipeline, identifies competency gaps, and coordinates relevant training and development programmes to improve Partner capability and organizational performance.


Key Responsibilities
Recruitment & Talent Acquisition:


	Manage recruitment activities for approved vacancies across the Group.
	Source qualified candidates through appropriate recruitment platforms, professional networks, referrals, and other channels.
	Review applications and CVs against approved Job Descriptions and recruitment requirements.
	Conduct initial candidate screening and competency-based interviews.
	Prepare qualified candidates for interview panels and coordinate interview schedules.
	Maintain an updated recruitment tracker and candidate database.
	Coordinate reference checks, pre-employment documentation, offer issuance, and onboarding activities.
	Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical and recurring positions.
	Support recruitment for technical, engineering, construction, corporate, and professional positions as required.


Training Needs Analysis & Development:


	Coordinate the Company's Training Needs Analysis (TNA) across departments and business units.
	Identify competency and performance gaps through approved assessment methods, performance reviews, departmental inputs, and Management requirements.
	Consolidate identified training needs and prepare training priorities for Management review.
	Develop and maintain an annual training and development plan based on identified competency gaps and organizational priorities.
	Recommend appropriate internal and external training interventions.


Training Coordination:


	Coordinate approved training programmes, workshops, seminars, technical training, and professional development activities.
	Liaise with approved training providers, consultants, facilitators, and institutions.
	Coordinate training schedules, nominations, attendance, materials, venues, and other training requirements.
	Maintain complete records of Partner participation in training and development programmes.
	Monitor completion of mandatory and approved training programmes.
	Coordinate post-training evaluations and gather feedback on training effectiveness.


Learning & Development Records:

	The incumbent will lead a team of Project Managers and work closely with Software Development, Quality Assurance, Infrastructure, Support, Product Management, and Business teams to ensure successful delivery of mission-critical software solutions to banks and other financial institutions.

Ideal Candidate Profile


	A seasoned technology project leader with extensive experience overseeing software development and deployment projects for banks and financial institutions, capable of leading enterprise-wide project portfolios, improving delivery governance, and ensuring successful execution of the company&#39;s strategic objectives.

PMO Leadership and Governance:


	Establish and manage the Project Management Office (PMO).
	Develop and enforce project management frameworks, methodologies, policies, standards, and best practices.
	Define project governance models and reporting structures.
	Ensure consistent application of project management principles across all projects.
	Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the PMO.


Project Portfolio Management:


	Oversee the organization&#39;s portfolio of software development, implementation, integration, upgrade, and deployment projects.
	Prioritize projects based on strategic business objectives and resource availability.
	Monitor project performance and portfolio health.
	Ensure alignment between project delivery and corporate strategy.
	Provide executive visibility into project status, risks, costs, and resource requirements.


Software Delivery Oversight:


	Oversee the successful delivery of banking and financial software solutions.
	Ensure projects follow established Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes.
	Monitor software development, testing, deployment, and implementation activities.
	Ensure timely delivery while maintaining quality and compliance standards.
	Work closely with technical teams to resolve delivery challenges.


Client and Stakeholder Management:


	Build and maintain strategic relationships with banking clients and executive stakeholders.
	Participate in business development discussions and client engagements.
	Manage project escalations and critical client issues.
	Lead executive project reviews, steering committee meetings, and stakeholder forums.
	Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and service delivery excellence.


Resource and Capacity Management:


	Manage project resource planning across the organization.
	Optimize utilization of Project Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, QA Engineers, and other delivery resources.
	Identify resource gaps and support workforce planning initiatives.
	Collaborate with department heads on staffing requirements.


Financial and Commercial Management:


	Oversee project budgets and financial performance.
	Monitor project profitability and cost control measures.
	Review project estimates, pricing assumptions, and delivery commitments.
	Support contract negotiations and commercial discussions where required.
	Ensure revenue realization through successful project execution.


Risk, Compliance and Quality Management:


	Establish project risk management frameworks.
	Monitor enterprise-level project risks and dependencies.
	Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements applicable to banking and financial institutions.
	Promote quality assurance practices throughout project lifecycles.
	Ensure adherence to information security and data protection standards.


Leadership and People Management:


	Lead, mentor, and develop Project Managers and PMO staff.
	Create a high-performance project management culture.
	Define performance objectives and conduct performance evaluations.
	Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
	Drive leadership development within the PMO team.


Strategic Planning:


	Support executive management in strategic planning and execution.
	Provide insights and recommendations on project investments and delivery capabilities.
	Identify opportunities for process automation and operational efficiencies.
	Contribute to corporate growth and digital transformation initiatives.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Portfolio project delivery success rate
	Percentage of projects delivered on time and within budget
	Client satisfaction and retention rates
	PMO maturity improvement score
	Project profitability and revenue realization
	Resource utilization efficiency
	Reduction in project risks and escalations
	Successful deployment of banking software solutions
	Employee engagement and PMO team performance.


Qualifications
Education:


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
	Master&#39;s Degree (MBA or related field) is an advantage.


Professional Certifications
Required or highly preferred:


	Project Management Professional (PMP)
	PRINCE2 Practitioner
	PMI Program&nbsp;Management Professional (PgMP) (advantage)
	Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
	PMI-ACP
	Portfolio Management certifications are an added advantage


Experience:


	Minimum of 15 years of experience in project management within technology-driven organizations.
	At least 8 years in a PMO leadership or senior project delivery management role.
	Proven experience managing large-scale software development and deployment projects.
	Demonstrated experience delivering software solutions to banks, financial institutions, or fintech organizations.
	Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and cross-functional teams.
	Strong background in enterprise software implementation and systems integration.


Technical Knowledge:


	Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
	Agile, Scrum, Waterfall and Hybrid methodologies
	Banking Technology Solutions
	Digital Banking Platforms
	Payment Systems
	Core Banking Applications
	Enterprise Integration Projects
	API Development and Integration
	Cloud Technologies (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)
	IT Service Management (ITIL)
	Cybersecurity and Information Security Standards.


Core Competencies
Leadership:


	Strategic Leadership
	Organizational Development
	Executive Presence
	Team Building
	Change Management.


Project &amp; Portfolio Management:


	Portfolio Management
	Program Management
	Budget Management
	Resource Planning
	Governance and Compliance
	Risk Management.


Business Competencies:


	Client Relationship Management
	Commercial Awareness
	Contract Management
	Negotiation Skills
	Business Process Improvement.


Personal Attributes


	Strong analytical capability
	Excellent communication and presentation skills
	Results-driven mindset
	High emotional intelligence
	Strong decision-making ability
	Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


Method of Application&nbsp;
